about.what: This is a free site for playing Shogi, Japanese chess. No account, no ads.
about.free: Play the computer, play a friend online or on one device, and learn the rules with lessons.
about.whatBody: Shogi is the traditional chess of Japan, played for around five hundred years in its present form. What makes it its own game is the hand: a captured piece changes owner and can be dropped back onto almost any empty square, so material is never really gone and attacks never really end. Pieces that reach the last three ranks may turn over and promote — most of them to a gold general. A pawn may not be dropped onto a file where you already have one, and may never be dropped to deliver checkmate. Sente moves first.
